summary: Use the Warden App (agentic wallet) via browser automation to execute crypto tasks (swap, bridge, deposit/withdraw, perps, portfolio/research) and to build an OpenClaw skill wrapper other agents can use. Use when you need to (1) navigate the Warden UI, (2) connect a wallet, (3) place trades/swaps, (4) check balances/positions, or (5) document repeatable Warden workflows safely (no key leakage, explicit confirmations).
